<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Claim processing stalls when reserve changes require approval but the designated approver is unavailable and no delegate is assigned. This creates backlogs because there’s no alternative path to move claims forward.",
 "similar": [

   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4135",
   "similarity": 0.053,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's claim information display provides a clear, real-time overview of active claims, including status, assigned adjuster, and key dates, helping users stay informed without switching screens.\", \"id\": 4135, \"name\": \"Claim information display\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {

   "record": "{\"id\": \"3d6f7b4a-ed9c-52d3-97a0-2d967a79bcf2\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Policyholder milestone notifications\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Policyholder milestone notifications\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Keelwater will automatically notify policyholders when they reach key milestones in their claims process, such as document submission completion, adjuster assignment, or payout approval, helping them stay informed without needing to check status manually.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Keelwater will automatically notify policyholders when they reach key milestones in their claims process, such as document submi"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4127",
   "similarity": 0.039,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-10-06T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Users can now upload multiple documents at once to a claim in Keelwater, streamlining the process and reducing manual effort for claims handlers.\", \"id\": 4127, \"name\": \"Bulk upload documents to a claim\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4136",
   "similarity": 0.038,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is updating its supplier address fields to support international formats and improve data validation, ensuring accurate claim processing across global regions.\", \"id\": 4136, \"name\": \"Supplier address fields\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },

  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem statement claims that claim processing stalls when reserve changes require approval but the designated approver is unavailable and no delegate is assigned, creating backlogs with no alternative path forward. I checked the five most similar stories and roadmap items: Shortcut 4135 'Claim information display' (started, not completed), the Notion roadmap page 'Policyholder milestone notifications', Shortcut 4127 'Bulk upload documents to a claim' (completed 2026-10-06), Shortcut 4136 'Supplier address fields' (started, not completed), and Shortcut 4128 'Claim search refinements' (completed 2026-09-15). None of these address approver unavailability, delegate assignment, or any alternative path for reserve-change approvals; the shipped stories cover document uploads and claim filtering, while the remaining items concern claim display, policyholder notifications, and address validation. The core problem is therefore not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item.", "verdict": "pass"}
